description_en: Calls DeleteVbrHa to delete a VBR failover group
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-vbr-ha --instance-id vbrha-sa1000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVbrHa

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VBR failover group, which is returned by the CreateVbrHa operation. When you create a failover group, the two VBRs must be in the same region, added to the same Express Connect Router (ECR) or the same Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, and both must have BFD enabled
parameters.help_zh: VBR倒换组实例ID，由CreateVbrHa接口返回。创建倒换组时，两个VBR必须位于同一地域，加入同一个专线网关ECR或同一个云企业网，并均已开启BFD
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the VBR
parameters.name: region_id
